subject: New Manager Field Readiness & Difficult Conversations — pilot plan
messages:
From: Ada HR <ada.hr@acme.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: New manager onboarding: field readiness + difficult conversations module

Hi Kimberly,

We ran the new manager intake this quarter and several accounts (Acme Corp included) have asked for a short pilot focused on manager field readiness — specifically a module on performance conversations and handling sensitive escalations in customer-facing teams.

We have a training vendor (OnPoint Training) that proposes a 2-session pilot: 90 minutes focus on difficult conversations + 60 minutes practical role-play. I attached a one-page outline (manager_training_outline.pdf) and their rough pricing.

As the local People Ops lead for Acme, I wanted to check availability for a pilot cohort (10 managers) in late March / early April. Can you: 1) confirm Redwood will host/work with vendor, 2) share any scheduling constraints, and 3) confirm budget owner?

Attachments: manager_training_outline.pdf (PDF, 1 page)

Thanks —
Ada Nguyen
People Operations | Acme Corp
ada.hr@acme.com

---
Note: this is a vendor-driven pilot; Acme is requesting Redwood to provide coordination for internal managers and cover vendor facilitation fees for the first run.
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 16:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: New manager onboarding: field readiness + difficult conversations module

Marissa / Vivek — looping you both in on a vendor request from Acme (Ada). They want a pilot for ~10 managers with an emphasis on difficult conversations and escalation handling. Attached below is the vendor outline Ada sent.

High level ask: Redwood to coordinate internal scheduling, host the session (virtual), and cover facilitation fees for the pilot as a customer enablement gesture.

Please see quick asks:
- Marissa: can you own logistics (invite list, slides, virtual room) if we greenlight?
- Vivek: confirm whether we can use a $6k budget (one-time) from customer success enablement — or suggest alternate cost center.
- Laura: tagging you for exec approval on budget + any constraints for customer-facing training tied to enterprise accounts.

Proposed pilot windows (I think Marissa can confirm availability):
  * Option A: Tue/Thu week of Mar 30 (two sessions on Tue 9:30–11:00 PT; Thu 9:30–10:30 PT)
  * Option B: Apr 6–8 (two shorter back-to-back evenings for EMEA overlap)

If we proceed, I suggest a small evaluation: pre/post survey + 30-day follow-up with net change in escalation rate (tracked by CS). Laura — would like your thoughts on KPIs.

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: New manager onboarding: field readiness + difficult conversations module

Kimberly — happy to own logistics. I spoke with OnPoint this morning and they can run two 75-minute sessions (scenario + role-play) the week of Mar 30 or the week of Apr 6. Their recommended plan for a pilot (10 managers) is attached as the pilot-agenda.docx and a sample attendee CSV (attendee-list.csv). Pricing they quoted: $5,500 for the two sessions + materials.

My suggested process:
- Confirm vendor and dates (we pick Option A: Mar 30 / Apr 1)
- Send invites and pre-read 2 weeks ahead
- Run session, collect 5-question pre/post survey
- 30-day check-in with CS to measure changes in escalation volume and manager confidence

Open questions:
- Do we want the session recorded for broader L&D? (Vendor charges an extra $500 for recording & materials distribution)
- Should we prioritize US-focused managers first or mix with EMEA? (My preference: US pilot, then EMEA run)

Attachments: pilot-agenda.docx (Word, 2 pages), attendee-list.csv (CSV)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: New manager onboarding: field readiness + difficult conversations module

Thanks — quick budget note: CS enablement has $4k available this quarter. We can cover $4k from that budget and propose covering the remaining $1,500–$2,000 from post-sales marketing or customer success promotions if needed. If the vendor will accept $5,000 we can absorb the gap; otherwise I can request a one-off spend approval from finance (will take ~3 business days).

I support the US-first pilot. Also +1 on recording the session; that helps scale the content for future cohorts. For KPIs, recommend: 1) manager confidence (survey delta), 2) escalation incidents per manager (30 day change), 3) follow-up coaching uptake (number of 1:1 coaching sessions booked after training).

If Marissa can firm up dates, I'll start the finance ticket.

Thank you all for the quick coordination. Approve the pilot under the following conditions:

1) Total spend capped at $6k (vendor + recording) — OK to split across CS enablement + marketing as Vivek suggested.
2) HR (Ada) signs the participant data handling agreement (we need to ensure no customer PII is used in role-plays).
3) We use the attached pilot-kpis-template.xlsx to capture pre/post measures + a 30-day escalation check.

Marissa: please schedule the US pilot for Tue Mar 30 (9:30–11:00 PT) and Thu Apr 1 (9:30–10:30 PT). Include recording add-on and collect pre-read acceptance.

Kimberly: please confirm the vendor contract routing and mark deal ID in HubSpot (linked). Once we have the signed participant agreement from Ada, proceed.

Attachments: pilot-kpis-template.xlsx (Excel)
